status: Hardware reached L0 on its first XNU poll after enabling the missing CNSS GPIO18/19 PDC wake forwarding; later PCI resource initialization still fails
root_cause_scope: Missing PDC wake forwarding caused the observed Detect.Quiet failure in the tested initialization sequence. Full Wi-Fi operation is not verified.

hardware_test.next_failure: stage=2 error=4; old code aliases GWP_BAD_CAPABILITY and BAR mapping failure. Integrated terminal build adds the exact failure site.

source_evidence.cnss: cnss_get_pinctrl iterates mpm_wake_set_gpios and calls msm_gpio_mpm_wake_set(gpio,1)
source_evidence.pinctrl: pinctrl-msm.c tests GPIO_INTR_CFG[6] and sets [7] for PDC-mapped pins
source_evidence.stock_module: cnss2.ko cnss_get_pinctrl relocation at 0x22510 calls msm_gpio_mpm_wake_set
source_evidence.pin_map: pinctrl-pineapple.c maps GPIO18 to PDC75 and GPIO19 to PDC63; both have wake_bit=-1

behavior: Configure forwarding before regulator votes and WLAN_EN
Preserve GPIO input/output/mux and CPU interrupt configuration
Reject absent hardware capability or dropped writes
Restore only the changed forwarding bit on failed UEFI preparation
Require both routes enabled in XNU before releasing PERST
Log named XNU error codes; 5 means GWL_LINK_TIMEOUT, never an error count
